new_issues: Codex's massless 2.238 and the 'roughly 1.9-fold' gap are single orbit-phase values: orbit-mean massless 1.88, Hartree 1.166, ratio 1.61; instantaneous ratio 0.96-2.54 (massless correlates +0.94 with |chibar|^2).

The linear-phi control's 2.09x sits at its orbital peak (max 2.109 at tau 796); its orbit mean first exceeds 1 in the cycle tau 729-773 (1.12). Nonlinear and control separate from fragmentation (tau ~70-85).

Most of both reference counts sits in modes that were never seeded: k<1.8 holds 1.87/2.24 (massless) and 0.84/1.18 (Hartree). These modes start at exactly zero, yet they are Floquet-unstable (mu 0.23-0.60) and box-limited (L=16: 2.41/1.27, k<1 1.40). The count is therefore largely nonlinear transfer into box-scale modes whose initial state is unspecified.

One L=16 run cannot separate volume from realization variance: the L=16 shifts (Q0/Q +0.092, massless +0.17, Hartree +0.086) are comparable to the L=12 seed-to-seed shift (+0.104, -0.18, +0.032). Its lowest seeded shell is 1.842 (n^2=21 gives 1.7996<1.8) versus 1.814 at L=12.
The isotropic Hartree m^2 contains the oscillating condensate (14.8-25.8 over an orbit), so the Hartree variants spread by up to 34% away from the tau-800 phase.
